title: A zero-token software factory
thesis: Every question a parse, a count, a path check or a set difference can answer is answered before the agent opens, and the agent is billed only for judgement.
falsified_by: one orientation question the agent still has to ask that a static pass could have answered
unit: one subsystem, with its contract, its states, its gate and its acceptance command

reference.why: The lanes are sized against a real implementation of this system rather than a guess. Every payload number below is measured off that tree by bb's own estimator, not asserted. The unwired orientation term is measured against that same tree: it is the thing a session has to survey when nothing hands it a brief.

gates.full: npm run lint && npm test && node bin/bb.js selftest

surfaces.why: what is wrong, with evidence, for nothing
what to do about it, packed to one window
who does it, where, in what wave
what a session used and was spared, separately

lanes.title: the core: paths, config, fs, exec, store, util, args, log
lanes.owes: one implementation per fact: one walker, one fingerprint, one estimator

lanes.title: the detectors and the shared corpus they all read once
lanes.owes: every finding carries evidence and a key stable across runs; a detector that throws is a row, never a crash

lanes.title: the local actuators that close what they can before a model is asked
lanes.owes: a patch written to disk before a file is changed; dry run until --apply

lanes.title: compile: findings to units, packed to one window with quoted regions
lanes.owes: projected = overhead + brief + payload x churn + reserve, with each term shown

lanes.title: route: units to lanes and waves, conflicts as affinity
lanes.owes: a split that respects directory locality, because locality is what a cache prefix is made of

lanes.title: run: lanes on the chosen agent, env allowlist, acceptance as the verdict
lanes.owes: the prompt and the command are written to disk before anything is spawned; unproven blocks --pr

lanes.title: tokens: estimate, calibrate, probe, price, and the session bill
lanes.owes: measured and estimated are never added and never printed the same way

lanes.title: designlabs: the doctrine, the declared system and the gate that holds it
lanes.owes: a rule a browser alone can settle reports unknown, never pass

lanes.title: wire: the instruction block, the MCP entry and the hooks, per agent
lanes.owes: unwire removes only its own blocks, byte for byte

lanes.title: the CLI: one entrypoint, every verb, a broken module is a row not a crash
lanes.owes: every verb is a dry run until --apply; only run and bridge send can spend

target_note: The budget one wave of this build is allowed to occupy, agent-side, through the wire. A wave over it is SPLIT, not accepted with a bigger number.

waves.title: the zero-token spine
waves.why: nothing downstream can be sized until a parse can say what is wrong and what it costs

waves.title: packing and dispatch
waves.why: findings become units, units become lanes, lanes become the only verb that spends

waves.title: measuring and wiring
waves.why: what a session used and was spared, and how the factory installs itself into every agent
